name: @w6w-apps/knack
description: Read, create, update and delete records in a Knack app's tables over its object-based REST API.

w6w.longDescription:
Knack is a no-code database and app builder: every customer builds their own schema of Objects (tables) and Fields inside their own Knack application, then Knack generates a REST API over exactly that schema. This app is built around the one surface every Knack app shares regardless of what its builder designed — object-based record CRUD — because nothing else about a Knack app's API is fixed in advance.

Each action takes the target Object's key (`object_1`, `object_2`, …) as a parameter, since a single Connection's credential can reach every table in the app, not just one. List records with Knack's own filter/sort/pagination query language, fetch one by its record ID, and create, update or delete records by posting the field values your Knack app defines (`field_1`, `field_2`, …).

Knack's REST API publishes no schema-discovery endpoint and no generic whoami: every authenticated route, without exception, is scoped to an Object or a View. That shapes two things worth knowing before connecting — a Connection needs one real Object key up front just to verify the credential is live, and finding your app's Object and Field keys is a Builder task (enable System Fields on a table, or open the object's settings), not an API call this app can make for you.
